movieTypeValidation: All 957 source records are Title Type = Movie.
knownLimitations: This is a migration and partial research snapshot, not a completed research pass for all 957 movies.
Status values existing-character-data mean profiles exist but do not have a complete researched actor-to-character cast mapping.
The 655 not-researched movies have no character profiles in the current detail snapshot; this is not evidence that they have no characters.
The 3,807 imported character profiles have no verified image URLs in the source file; image fields remain empty.
Aliases, occupations, origin details, and many descriptions are not supplied for most existing profiles; unknown values remain empty or Unknown.
No pre-existing power, weapon, or tool catalogue was supplied in the current movie data. Only one power and one weapon were added from the two reviewed movie plots; tools remain empty.
The older 705-character / 110-title snapshot uses a different, non-overlapping ID set and was deliberately not merged with the newer 3,807-character snapshot.
Character.role is intentionally omitted from characters.json because the same character has different roles in different movies. Role is authoritative in characterAppearances.json.
Duplicate display names across different movie-specific IDs were not auto-merged; same-name matches require continuity-level verification.
